text:
Rae (People Ops): Quick sync — planning a small "Spotlight Snack" pop-up next Thursday at 2:30pm. Idea: hand out snack packs + a 1-line recognition card people can fill out. Low-key, informal.
Nora (HR): Sounds good. Are these considered spot awards or just swag? Need to confirm policy.
Rae (People Ops): Culture-first swag. If a manager later requests cash conversion, we'll route through the spot-award flow.
Sam - Eng: How will nominations work? Open nominations or on-site shoutouts?
Rae (People Ops): Both. We'll run a 48hr open form for nominations, and leave paper cards on the table for on-the-spot notes.
Priya - Prod: I can make the Google Form and a 2-line Slack announcement. Also happy to print 80 cards.
Olive (Facilities): For snacks I need a headcount by Tuesday 11am. I can reserve the east lobby table and order vegan options.
Rae (People Ops): Volunteer slots: setup 2:00-2:25, host 2:30-3:15, teardown 3:15-3:30. Who can volunteer?
Sam - Eng: I'll do teardown.
Priya - Prod: I'll do setup and run the form.
Nora (HR): I'll quickly review the announcement wording and confirm the conversion policy by EOD Monday.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Jamie nominated Lina for shipping a tiny UX fix that helped onboarding flow! :sparkles:"
Rae (People Ops): Great. We'll share nominees list at 2pm Thursday so volunteers can prompt folks for quick shoutouts. I'll post the announcement tomorrow.
notes: Spotlight Snack pop-up; open nominations 48hrs; volunteer slots; headcount deadline Tue 11am; HR to check conversion policy
